title: MIS cum System Admin
description:
**Job Title:** MIS cum System Administrator  
**Experience Required:** 2 to 5 years  
**Job Location:** Burrabazar, Kolkata  
**Job Type:** Full-time**Job Purpose**We are looking for a versatile and detail-oriented **MIS cum System Administrator** with **2 to 5 years of experience** to bridge the gap between our data reporting and internal IT infrastructure. In this dual role, you will be responsible for **managing data pipelines, generating actionable MIS reports**, and **maintaining the health, security, and performance of our hardware, software, and network systems**. [1, 2]The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical capabilities alongside excellent technical troubleshooting skills to ensure zero operational downtime and robust data accuracy. [1, 2]

**Key Responsibilities1. Management Information Systems (MIS) & Data Analytics (50%)**

* **Data Compilation & Validation:** Extract, clean, and consolidate operational, financial, or sales data from multiple sources to maintain a "single source of truth". [1, 2]
* **Report Generation:** Create and deliver accurate daily, weekly, and monthly MIS dashboards and performance summaries for leadership. [1, 2]
* **Automation:** Automate routine data-pulling and reporting tasks using Excel macros, advanced functions, or scripting to increase department efficiency. [1]
* **Ad-Hoc Analysis:** Conduct deep-dive data reconciliation and trend analysis to help stakeholders make informed business decisions. [1]

**2. System Administration & IT Support (50%)**

* **Infrastructure Maintenance:** Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain office servers, workstations, routers, switches, and peripheral hardware.
* **User & Access Management:** Manage user accounts, email configurations, permissions, and group policies using **Active Directory** or cloud equivalents (O365/Google Workspace).
* **Network & Security Operations:** Monitor network connectivity (LAN/WAN, VPN), troubleshoot firewalls, and ensure up-to-date antivirus/cybersecurity protocols.
* **Backup & Disaster Recovery:** Execute and verify routine automated system backups to ensure business continuity and data integrity.
* **Technical Troubleshooting:** Provide tier-1 and tier-2 IT support for hardware malfunctions, software glitches, and internet connectivity bottlenecks. [1, 2, 3, 4]

**Required Technical Skills & Toolsets**DomainMust-Have Technical Skills**Data & MIS**Advanced **MS Excel** (VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, Index/Match, Pivot Tables, Macros), **SQL** for database querying.**BI Tools**Familiarity with **Power BI**, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools.**OS & Directory**Windows Server administration, Linux basics, and **Active Directory** management.**Networking**Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN configurations, and routing.**Cloud/Productivity**Google Workspace (Sheets, Forms, Apps-script) or Microsoft Office 365 environments.**Qualifications & Soft Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications (BCA/MCA), or a related numerical discipline (Math/Statistics).
* **Certifications (Preferred):** Relevant certifications like CCNA, CompTIA Network+/Security+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals, or MCSA will be highly valued.
* **Problem-Solving:** Strong logical ability to diagnose technical system bugs and data discrepancies quickly.
* **Communication:** Ability to break down complex technical layouts or data trends into clear concepts for non-technical teams.
* **Time Management:** Capable of multitasking between urgent IT support tickets and time-sensitive daily MIS deadlines. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]

Pay: From ₹12,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
